courses.title: Foundations of Indian Statistics
courses.description: Covers basic statistical concepts including mean, median, mode, standard deviation, and probability fundamentals.

courses.title: Advanced Statistical Methods
courses.description: Regression analysis, time series, hypothesis testing, and multivariate analysis for government statisticians.

courses.title: Macroeconomic Indicators for Policy
courses.description: Understanding GDP, inflation, fiscal deficit, balance of payments, and their policy implications.

courses.title: Advanced Macroeconomic Modeling
courses.description: Building macroeconomic models, CGE models, and econometric analysis for national planning.

courses.title: National Accounts Statistics - Basics
courses.description: GDP computation using production approach, GVA estimation, sector classification, and base year methodology.

courses.title: Advanced National Accounts & NSDP
courses.description: State-level domestic product estimation, inter-sectoral comparisons, GDP revision process, and chain-linking methods.

courses.title: Sample Registration System - Overview
courses.description: SRS sampling framework, dual record system, CBR, CDR, IMR, and TFR computation methods.

courses.title: Advanced SRS & Demographic Analysis
courses.description: SRS-based study design, life table construction, mortality analysis, and population projections.

courses.title: IoT for Government Data Collection
courses.description: Introduction to IoT sensors, smart data collection, real-time monitoring for government applications.

courses.title: IoT Integration with Statistical Systems
courses.description: Integrating IoT data streams with databases, MQTT protocols, and real-time dashboards.

courses.title: Data Dissemination Standards
courses.description: SDDS compliance, data publication calendars, metadata standards, and transparency in official statistics.

courses.title: Advanced Data Pipelines & SDMX
courses.description: Building automated data pipelines, SDMX implementation, and statistical data management.
